reason: A memory backend plugin for DeepSeek Harness that connects agent sessions to a memoria service for observing, storing, searching, and recalling memories, with optional automatic writes and namespace configuration.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 智能体会话连接到 memoria 服务，以支持记忆的自动沉淀、存储、搜索和召回。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness agent sessions to a memoria service for automatic observation, storage, search, and recall of memories.

capabilities: Stores conversation-derived content in a configured memoria service
Searches and recalls stored memories using semantic and keyword signals
Automatically observes conversations and may remember positively rated feedback
Sends authenticated requests to a configurable external service using an environment-provided token
Applies a configured memory namespace to reads and writes
